ratings.name: Gameplay & Design Rating
ratings.description: How the game plays, feels, and engages the player.

factors.name: Core Gameplay Loop
factors.description: Engagement and satisfaction of repeated gameplay actions.

factors.name: Controls & Responsiveness
factors.description: Accuracy and reliability of player inputs.

factors.name: Difficulty Balance
factors.description: Fairness and scalability of challenge.

factors.name: Mechanics Depth
factors.description: Complexity and mastery of game systems.

factors.name: Progression Design
factors.description: Pacing and reward structure over time.

factors.name: Level Design
factors.description: Layout, flow, and creativity of playable spaces.

factors.name: Replayability
factors.description: Motivation to replay or continue playing.

ratings.name: Graphics & Art Rating
ratings.description: Visual quality, style, and clarity of presentation.

factors.name: Art Direction
factors.description: Cohesiveness and creativity of the visual style.

factors.name: Visual Fidelity
factors.description: Technical quality and detail of graphics.

factors.name: Animation Quality
factors.description: Smoothness and expressiveness of animations.

factors.name: Character Design
factors.description: Visual appeal and uniqueness of characters.

factors.name: Environment Design
factors.description: Quality and variety of environments.

factors.name: UI Visuals
factors.description: Aesthetic quality and clarity of the user interface.

factors.name: Visual Readability
factors.description: Ease of understanding visual information during gameplay.

adjustments.name: Art Feel
adjustments.description: Analyst's subjective impression of the art.

ratings.name: Game Quality Score Rating
ratings.description: Average of Gameplay & Design and Graphics & Art ratings.

ratings.name: Monetization & Value Rating
ratings.description: Fairness, pricing, and value offered to the player.

factors.name: Content Value
factors.description: Amount and quality of content for the price.

factors.name: Monetization Fairness
factors.description: Player-friendly and ethical monetization practices.

factors.name: DLC / Expansion Quality
factors.description: Value and quality of additional paid content.

factors.name: Pay-to-Win Risk
factors.description: Impact of monetization on gameplay balance.

factors.name: Progression Grind
factors.description: Time investment required to advance.

factors.name: Long-Term Value
factors.description: Replay potential and ongoing post-launch support.

ratings.name: Final Rating
ratings.description: Final weighted score combining quality and monetization.
